tagline.zh: 文档流内的四色警示块:不夺键盘焦点、默认不自动消失,经 role=alert 播报——与 toast(浮层自动消失)和 Dialog(阻断)三分反馈职责。
tagline.en: A four-tone warning block in the document flow: never steals focus, does not auto-dismiss, announced via role=alert — splitting feedback duty with toast (floating, auto-dismiss) and Dialog (blocking).

origin.zh: 语义取自 W3C APG Alert 模式:role=alert 显示简短重要消息、动态插入时多数屏幕阅读器自动播报、不得夺取键盘焦点;APG 特别告诫避免自动消失(WCAG 2.2.3)与频繁打断(2.2.4)。实现参数参照 Ant Design Alert:type 默认 info、showIcon/closable/banner 默认 false(antd 6.7.1 核对,调研 07§9 与 design-study 06§4.13)。
origin.en: Semantics from the W3C APG Alert pattern: role=alert shows a short important message, auto-announced by most screen readers on dynamic insertion, never stealing keyboard focus; APG specifically warns against auto-dismissing (WCAG 2.2.3) and frequent interruptions (2.2.4). Implementation follows Ant Design Alert: type default info, showIcon/closable/banner default false (antd 6.7.1, research 07 §9, design-study 06 §4.13).

effect.zh: 语义四态(JS 型参数)。AntD Alert type 默认 **info**;banner 模式下默认翻转为 **warning**。配色遵循 antd seed 功能色:success #52c41a / info(primary)#1677ff / warning #faad14 / error #ff4d4f;浅底与描边按「Bg=阶1、Border=阶3」规则派生。
effect.en: Four semantic states (JS-type param). AntD Alert type defaults to **info**; banner mode flips the default to **warning**. Colors follow antd seed functional tokens: success #52c41a / info(primary) #1677ff / warning #faad14 / error #ff4d4f; pale fills and borders derive via the 'Bg=step1, Border=step3' palette rule.

effect.zh: 是否提供手动关闭按钮(JS 型参数)。AntD Alert closable 默认 **false**。警告默认常驻(这正是它与 toast 的分界:APG 告诫警告不要自动消失,WCAG 2.2.3);开启关闭钮后由用户决定何时移除。
effect.en: Whether a manual close button is offered (JS-type param). AntD Alert closable defaults to **false**. Alerts persist by default — exactly the boundary with toast (APG warns alerts must not auto-dismiss, WCAG 2.2.3); with the close button the user decides when to remove it.

effect.zh: 是否显示语义图标(JS 型参数)。AntD Alert showIcon 默认 **false**;banner 模式下默认翻转为 **true**。图标与颜色双通道编码(NN/g 错误准则⑤:图标+颜色照顾色盲),扫读时先认形状再读文字。
effect.en: Whether the semantic icon shows (JS-type param). AntD Alert showIcon defaults to **false**; banner mode flips the default to **true**. Icons add a second channel beside color (NN/g error guideline 5: icon + color for color-blind users) — shape first, then text, when scanning.

effect.zh: 是否渲染为页面顶部通栏(JS 型参数)。AntD Alert banner 默认 **false**;开启后去掉圆角与侧边框、横向铺满,且 type/showIcon 默认翻转为 warning/true——通栏常用于站点级公告(维护、存储告急)。
effect.en: Whether to render as a full-width top banner (JS-type param). AntD Alert banner defaults to **false**; when on, radius and side borders drop, it spreads full-width, and type/showIcon defaults flip to warning/true — banners suit site-level notices (maintenance, storage warnings).

note.zh: 实现为普通文档流块级元素 + CSS color-mix 派生浅底,均为 Baseline 能力;color-mix 自 2023 年起全浏览器可用,不支持时浅底退化为白底(信息不受影响)。
note.en: Implemented as ordinary flow-level blocks with color-mix-derived pale fills, all Baseline; color-mix is available across browsers since 2023, degrading to a white fill where unsupported (message unaffected).

fallback.zh: 不支持 color-mix 的旧环境直接用功能色描边 + 白底即可读;图标用 SVG currentColor 着色,不依赖图片加载;关闭按钮必须是真实 button,不能只靠 CSS 隐藏。
fallback.en: Without color-mix, older environments stay readable with the functional-color border on white; icons are SVG currentColor so no image loading is involved; the close button must be a real button, never hidden by CSS alone.

use.zh: 页面级/表单顶部的整体性错误与状态说明(Carbon:整体性错误用行内通知)
use.en: Page-level or form-top summary errors and status notes (Carbon: overall errors as inline notifications)

use.zh: 存储告急、维护公告等站点级通栏(banner)
use.en: Site-level banners: storage warnings, maintenance notices

use.zh: 成功/结果确认等需要驻留直到用户读完的反馈
use.en: Success/outcome feedback that must remain until read

avoid.zh: 自动消失——那是 toast 的职责;警告自动消失太快违反 WCAG 2.2.3(APG)
avoid.en: Auto-dismissal — that is toast's job; fast-disappearing alerts violate WCAG 2.2.3 (APG)

avoid.zh: 必须处理才能继续的信息——用 alertdialog(APG:要打断用户就升级为对话框)
avoid.en: Must-act-before-continue info — use an alertdialog (APG: escalate to a dialog when you must interrupt)

avoid.zh: 字段级表单校验——错误要紧贴字段(NN/g 准则③)
avoid.en: Field-level form validation — errors belong next to the field (NN/g guideline 3)

avoid.zh: 一屏堆多个警告——信息噪音,合并为一条或改用页面结构承载
avoid.en: Stacking many alerts per screen — noise; merge into one or restructure the page

a11y.zh: 容器 role=alert,动态插入时多数屏幕阅读器自动播报(WAI-APG);不夺取键盘焦点——需要打断用户时改用 alertdialog;不要自动消失(违反 WCAG 2.2.3)、不要频繁出现(2.2.4);图标只作辅助,颜色+图标双通道避免「仅靠颜色传达」(WCAG 1.4.1);关闭按钮真实可聚焦并带 aria-label。
a11y.en: Container role=alert, auto-announced by most screen readers on dynamic insertion (WAI-APG); never takes focus — escalate to alertdialog when you must interrupt; no auto-dismiss (WCAG 2.2.3), no frequent interruptions (2.2.4); icons are auxiliary — color + icon dual-channel avoids color-only encoding (WCAG 1.4.1); close button is a real focusable control with aria-label.

goal.zh: 复刻四色警告提示:type 切换语义色、showIcon 加图标、closable 加关闭钮、banner 变顶部通栏;驻留文档流、role=alert、不自动消失。
goal.en: Replicate the four-tone alert: type switches semantic color, showIcon adds the icon, closable adds a close button, banner becomes a full-width top strip; stays in flow, role=alert, never auto-dismisses.

acceptance.zh: 容器 role=alert 且不夺焦点;默认常驻,关闭仅经真实按钮
acceptance.en: Container role=alert without focus theft; persists by default; closing only via a real button

acceptance.zh: 四态用 antd seed 功能色:#52c41a / #1677ff / #faad14 / #ff4d4f,浅底描边按阶1/阶3规则派生
acceptance.en: Four states use antd seed functional colors #52c41a / #1677ff / #faad14 / #ff4d4f, pale fill/border derived via step1/step3

acceptance.zh: banner=on 时通栏无圆角、内容下移让位,type/showIcon 默认翻转(warning/true)
acceptance.en: banner=on renders full-width without radius, content shifts down, and type/showIcon defaults flip (warning/true)

acceptance.zh: 图标 SVG currentColor 着色,颜色+图标双通道编码
acceptance.en: Icons colored via SVG currentColor; color+icon dual-channel encoding

acceptance.zh: 不引入自动消失计时;prefers-reduced-motion 无影响(无入场动画)
acceptance.en: No auto-dismiss timer; prefers-reduced-motion unaffected (no entrance animation)
